verdict.rationale: Munito AI's own docs list structured outputs among its capabilities, alongside OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API compatibility. However, the evidence is a single capability-list mention with no detail on JSON-schema enforcement, strict mode, grammar-constrained decoding, or which models support it. missing for 10: documented JSON-schema/response_format enforcement semantics, grammar support, per-model support details, independent or hands-on corroboration of reliable parsing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: Capabilities: structured outputs, tool calls, vision, speech to text, streaming, reasoning and prompt caching.
Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
